content:
maya: Starting AP-East1 cluster bootset A perf + kernel/driver validation. Goal: smoke throughput, p95 baseline, NVLink checks, NIC MTU, and quick disk IO. Handoff to eng-sre after green.

ravi: Copy. I'll run nvidia stack checks and a short gen bench (seq=1024, bs=8).

maya: Node image: rdx-runtime-2026-03-10, kernel `6.1.28`. GPUs: 8x A100 80GB, NICs: 2x 100G mlx5, MTU 9000.

ravi: Running `modinfo nvidia` + `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` now.

ops-bot: Job 5231 started: nvidia-stack-checks on node ap-east1-node-17 by ravi.

ravi: Paste outputs: 
```
# modinfo nvidia | grep ^version
version: 535.113.01
# nvidia-smi topo --matrix
        GPU0 GPU1 GPU2 GPU3
GPU0     X    NV   PHB  PHB
GPU1    NV    X    PHB  PHB
GPU2   PHB   PHB    X   NV
GPU3   PHB   PHB   NV    X
```

ravi: NVLink present between intended pairs, driver 535.113.01 OK. No UVM errors in dmesg head.

jordan: Quick NIC checks: `ethtool` shows 100G, lanes up. `ip link` sets MTU 9000; doing ping with 1k packets to measure fragmentation.

linh: Running disk fio to validate local NVMe for checkpointing: `fio --name=seqwrite --rw=write --bs=1m --size=2G --numjobs=4`.

ops-bot: Job 5232 finished: nvidia-stack-checks (success).

ravi: Short gen bench (internal gbench) results: batch=8, seq_len=1024, model variant: redwood-v1-small-quant.
```
throughput_per_gpu: 410 tokens/s
aggregate_throughput_8gpus: 3280 tokens/s
p50_latency_token: 6ms
p95_latency_token: 48ms
p99_latency_token: 120ms
```

ravi: These are with continuous batching on; kernel hotpath looks stable, no kernel oops.

maya: p95 48ms token-level is slightly above our expected 40ms baseline. Is this due to NVLink or CPU pinning?

jordan: I saw 2 transient IRQ soft-affinity shifts on the node during warmup. I'll repro with `isolcpus` and pinned CPU cores.

linh: Fio result: `IOPS=24k, bw=24GB/s, lat (avg)=0.7ms` — NVMe perf within expected.

ravi: Re-run gbench with CPU pinning (cpuset) and NIC interrupts isolated. New results:
```
throughput_per_gpu: 435 tokens/s
p95_latency_token: 36ms
p99_latency_token: 95ms
```

ravi: That dropped p95 below baseline. So root cause: CPU contention + IRQs interfering with kernel hotpath.

maya: Good catch. Action: pin inference threads to reserved cores in systemd unit, set irqaffinity for mlx5 queues. Add to bootstrap runbook.

jordan: Also saw one GPU with slightly higher ECC corrected errors counters during stress; looked transient. Will schedule a GPU memtest for that device.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance job 5239: memtest on GPU3 in 1h.

maya: Networking note: observed ~0.5% packet drops on one fabric port during peak; SFP vendor mismatch flagged. Ops flagged for swap if persists.

linh: Cost note for handoff: AP-East1 region has slightly higher spot pricing for spare A100 capacity — if we switch to reserved for Dedicated customers, update cost model.

ravi: Handoff checklist (quick):
- kernel/driver: nvidia 535.113.01, kernel 6.1.28 ✅
- NVLink topology verified ✅
- NVMe perf via fio ✅
- CPU irqaffinity & pinning applied ✅ (patch in /etc/systemd/system/rdx-inference.service.d/limits.conf)
- NIC MTU 9000 & ECN off/QLEN tuning applied ✅
- GPU memtest scheduled for GPU3 (follow-up) ⚠️
- perf baseline artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/ap-east1/1881239876/ ✅

maya: Upload path has logs + perf graphs. Ops, please run a 6h soak tomorrow and if green, handoff to eng-sre for production onboarding.

jordan: I'll start the soak job 1881240201 (6h soak) in 5m. Will monitor p95 token latency and NVLink error counters.

deploy-bot: Soak job 1881240201 started by jordan. Channels: #eng-infra, #eng-sre.

maya: Thanks team. If soak stays green, I will update the runbook entry: `ap-east1/bootstrap/2026-03-xx.md` with CPU pinning and IRQ guidance and then request formal handoff. :thumbsup:

ravi: re: follow-up, leaving a small tuning doc snippet in the runbook:
```
# irq pinning example
for q in $(ls /proc/irq | grep mlx5); do echo 2 > /proc/irq/$q/smp_affinity_list; done
systemctl set-property rdx-inference.service CPUAffinity=2-7
```

maya: Perfect. End of thread for root validation, will post final handoff once soak completes.

ops-bot: Job 5231 logs archived to s3://redwood-ops/logs/5231.tar.gz

maya: tagging @eng-sre for visibility and handover once soak is green.
